summary: Seattle, software engineer, strong interest in RISC-V architecture, advocates for universal basic income, supports legalizing all drugs, critical of corporate influence in politics, values transparency and accountability in government, prefers open-source solutions, emphasizes the importance of urban planning and public transportation, believes in the necessity of a social safety net, critical of the current education system, supports environmental sustainability, interested in automation and its impact on labor, advocates for progressive taxation, values community engagement and participation in governance.
